title: Multimodal AI for Geological-Hazard Investigation
subtitle: Structured geological information from field observations
question: Can multimodal AI extract structured geological information and support preliminary hazard interpretation from real-world field observations?
context: Field photographs and geological observations from engineering and geohazard investigation scenarios.
progress: Ongoing work emphasizes reproducibility, structured outputs, evaluation and domain consistency.
direction: Combining field imagery, spatial information, geological context and domain knowledge toward scalable geological investigation.
next: Evaluate structured outputs against geological observations and domain-consistent interpretation.
outputs: Research assets may include code, prompts, evaluation scripts, labels and model outputs. Public releases are forthcoming.
